meta.name: document-gen-unicode-safe
meta.description: Unicode-safe fallback workflow for multi-format document generation with character sanitization

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成多格式文档并自动清理异常字符
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要生成安全兼容的文档并处理乱码问题
copy.tagline_en: Generate multi-format documents with automatic character sanitization
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate documents safely and fix garbled characters

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据文档内容自动选择生成方式：简单文档直接调用 shell_agent 快速生成；遇到含特殊符号、多语言或需多格式时，手动分步处理并清理 Unicode 字符，确保 PDF 安全输出。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成 Word、PDF 或 HTML 文档时触发。Claude 会先评估文档中是否包含非 ASCII 字符或特殊符号，或历史尝试失败，从而决定采用快速或手动工作流。

say.note: 如果成功则完成，失败则自动转手动流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude adapts document generation: for simple documents it quickly delegates to shell_agent; for documents with special characters, non-ASCII text, or multiple formats, it manually creates and sanitizes content to ensure Unicode-safe PDF and other outputs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user requests document generation (e.g., Word, PDF, HTML). Claude evaluates content for Unicode complexity and past failures to decide between the quick path (shell_agent) or the manual workflow.
